prompt:
Image 1 is a finished game sprite sheet of a leader whose drawing is right: keep exactly its camera (high above and in front, looking down at about 40 degrees), the direction every figure faces, every figure's pose, size and position in its cell, the 4 by 4 grid and the flat pure magenta (#FF00FF) background.
Image 2 is this leader's own approved painted portrait. Every figure of Image 1 must become the woman of the portrait, seen full length from above.

Repaint every figure of Image 1 as the woman of Image 2, the same in every cell. Keep each figure's pose, the position of its arms, legs and weapon, and its outline as close as the new kit allows. She has these marks, and each one must be clearly visible at full size: (1) the hood of overlapping pale beech leaves, olive and light tan, pulled up over the head; (2) her long dark-brown braid hanging from under the hood over one shoulder; (3) the scarf of moss-green wool wound around the neck; (4) her freckled oval face with a row of small green paint dots along each cheekbone; (5) the small carved wooden wren on a cord at the chest; (6) the long knife of dark iron with a bone grip. She carries no shield. Paint the marks in the portrait's hand: painterly oil on a wood panel, visible directional brushwork, a muted earthy palette; nothing glows. Keep the daylight of Image 1 (a high sun from the upper left, a cool fill on the lower right); do not copy the portrait's candlelight, its dark background or its framing. She wears a Thornwood scout's kit instead of the kit of Image 1: her own hood of overlapping leaves worn up as the portrait shows it, joined to a short cape of the same leaves over the shoulders; a bark-brown leather jerkin with plain straps over a moss-green tunic; brown breeches and soft wrapped boots; weathered bark-brown skin; a long knife held in the hand that holds the weapon in Image 1, pointing the same way. She is lean and light: no helmet, no iron cap, no padded jerkin, no armour, no sword.

Facing, again: every figure in every one of the cells faces the same way, toward us and to the lower left, including the figure that is hit and the falling one; the fleeing figures alone turn away.

Background: one flat pure magenta (#FF00FF) colour fills the whole image with no gradient, texture, floor or shadow; no magenta, pink or purple anywhere on the figures. Never: text, labels, grid lines, borders, a floor, cast shadows, blood, extra people, cropped or overlapping figures.
